facts.statement: Researchers used structure-based drug design to discover a new drug called GTA182.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: In mice with human tumors, oral GTA182 caused tumor shrinkage in cancer cells lacking the MTAP gene but had little effect on cells with the normal gene.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The drug also reduced tumor size by 59% and extended survival beyond 91 days in a mouse model of brain cancer.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: A human clinical trial found that the drug was safe, shrank brain tumors, and helped about 30% of patients.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The authors conclude that GTA182 is a promising treatment option for cancers that have lost the MTAP gene.
facts.subject: other
